name: Search Snippet Extraction: Context Window Around Matching Terms
description: Search results show a preview snippet containing the searched keyword with 30 characters of surrounding context rather than the beginning of a 2,000-word article.
prompt:
Search results show a preview snippet containing the searched keyword with 30 characters of surrounding context rather than the beginning of a 2,000-word article.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: post_id, snippet_preview.
Row order does not matter.
golden_sql:
-- Extract 25-character window surrounding the word 'vectorized'
            SELECT 
                post_id,
                '...' || SUBSTRING(
                    content,
                    GREATEST(1, INSTR(lower(content), 'vectorized') - 15),
                    LENGTH('vectorized') + 30
                ) || '...' AS snippet_preview
            FROM blog_posts
            WHERE content ILIKE '%vectorized%';
why_it_fails: Substring extraction crashes when matching keywords appear near the very beginning or end of the text.
